configure terminal

Enter configuration commands, one per line. End with CNTL/Z.

host01(config)# ip route 198.51.100.0/24 192.0.2.250 19


host01(config)# ipv6 route 2001:db8::/32 2001:db8:ffff::fe    21


host01(config)# vrf context nxos-routing-admin


host01(config-vrf)# ip route 198.51.100.0/24 192.0.2.250


host01(config-vrf)# ipv6 route 2001:db8::/32 2001:db8:ffff::fe    23


host01(config-vrf)# exit


host01(config)# end


host01#
